artifact_types.gif: approved animation, not inferred game logic
artifact_types.glb: glTF Binary, may contain authored animation
artifact_types.json: typed scene / event / prefab / project metadata
artifact_types.html: static game entry point, not a guaranteed portable app

project_policy.physics_authority: single provider per scene, Rapier preferred
project_policy.postfx_authority: one EffectComposer and one render loop
project_policy.offline: promise only when actual local dependencies are bundled
